roots.description: Results of the actions that have run, by action id

fields.name: output
fields.description: Output data of the action, e.g. the list of files of file.list

fields.name: error
fields.description: Reason of the failure; empty if it succeeded

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the action, e.g. core.log

roots.name: row
roots.description: The current entry of forEach; only in actions with forEach

roots.name: request
roots.description: The request of the caller of an http trigger; nil if the run was not started by one

fields.name: query
fields.description: Query parameters by name (the first value of each)

fields.name: body
fields.description: The body: the JSON value, the fields of a form, or the text

functions.name: today
functions.description: Today, 00:00 local time

functions.name: now
functions.description: The current date and time

functions.name: formatDate
functions.description: Writes a date as text. Pattern letters: yyyy year, MM month, dd day, HH:mm:ss time, EEE weekday, MMMM month name, 'text' in quotes

functions.name: parseDate
functions.description: Reads a date from text with a pattern like formatDate

functions.name: addDays
functions.description: Adds days; negative numbers go back

functions.name: addHours
functions.description: Adds hours

functions.name: addMonths
functions.description: Adds months

functions.name: dayOfWeek
functions.description: Weekday: 1 Monday … 7 Sunday

functions.name: diffDays
functions.description: Days from one date to another

functions.name: upper
functions.description: Text in capital letters

functions.name: lower
functions.description: Text in small letters

functions.name: trim
functions.description: Removes spaces at the start and end

functions.name: replace
functions.description: Replaces all occurrences

functions.name: replaceRegex
functions.description: Replaces every match of a regular expression (write patterns with \ in backticks, e.g. `\d+`); new may use groups as $1 or ${name}, $$ for a $

functions.name: hasPrefix
functions.description: Whether a text starts with another (also the operator startsWith)

functions.name: hasSuffix
functions.description: Whether a text ends with another (also the operator endsWith)

functions.name: split
functions.description: Splits text into a list

functions.name: padLeft
functions.description: Fills on the left up to a length, e.g. 007; fill defaults to a space

functions.name: padRight
functions.description: Fills on the right up to a length

functions.name: substr
functions.description: Part of a text, counting from 0; length is optional

functions.name: left
functions.description: The first n characters

functions.name: right
functions.description: The last n characters

functions.name: concat
functions.description: Joins values with a separator and leaves out empty ones, so no separator stands alone; lists count with their entries

functions.name: normalize
functions.description: Replaces umlauts and ß, joins spaces – e.g. for file names

functions.name: basename
functions.description: Last part of a path or address, e.g. the file name; / and \ both separate

functions.name: dirname
functions.description: The path without its last part, e.g. the folder of a file; empty without a folder

functions.name: ext
functions.description: Ending of the file name with its dot, e.g. .zip; empty without one

functions.name: int
functions.description: Whole number from a number (cut off) or a text like '42'

functions.name: float
functions.description: Number from a whole number or a text like '1.5' (with a decimal point)

functions.name: string
functions.description: Any value as text, e.g. a number to join with text

functions.name: toJSON
functions.description: A value as JSON text, indented

functions.name: fromJSON
functions.description: The value of a JSON text: map, list, number, text or bool

functions.name: len
functions.description: Number of characters, entries of a list or keys of a map

functions.name: round
functions.description: Rounds to a whole number

functions.name: ceil
functions.description: Rounds up to a whole number

functions.name: floor
functions.description: Rounds down to a whole number

functions.name: abs
functions.description: The number without its sign

functions.name: min
functions.description: The smallest of the numbers or of a list

functions.name: max
functions.description: The largest of the numbers or of a list

functions.name: sum
functions.description: Sum of a list of numbers; with value, of a value of each entry

functions.name: join
functions.description: Joins a list of texts

functions.name: first
functions.description: The first entry; nil for an empty list

functions.name: last
functions.description: The last entry; nil for an empty list

functions.name: keys
functions.description: The keys of a map

functions.name: map
functions.description: A value of each entry, e.g. the sizes of files

functions.name: filter
functions.description: Keeps the entries for which the condition is true; # is the entry

functions.name: all
functions.description: Whether the condition is true for every entry

functions.name: any
functions.description: Whether the condition is true for at least one entry

functions.name: none
functions.description: Whether the condition is true for no entry

functions.name: one
functions.description: Whether the condition is true for exactly one entry

functions.name: count
functions.description: Number of entries for which the condition is true

functions.name: find
functions.description: The first entry for which the condition is true; nil if none

functions.name: findIndex
functions.description: Position (from 0) of the first entry for which the condition is true; -1 if none

functions.name: findLast
functions.description: The last entry for which the condition is true; nil if none

functions.name: findLastIndex
functions.description: Position (from 0) of the last entry for which the condition is true; -1 if none

functions.name: groupBy
functions.description: The entries in lists by a value of each, e.g. orders by customer

functions.name: sortBy
functions.description: The entries sorted by a value of each; order 'asc' (default) or 'desc'

functions.name: reduce
functions.description: Combines the entries to one value: #acc is the value so far (initial, else the first entry), # the entry

functions.name: coalesce
functions.description: The first value that is not empty

functions.name: isEmpty
functions.description: Whether a value is empty: nothing, empty text, list or map
